reason: After a delete, `removeMember` calls `findMembers` (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:40-48), which re-sends the old offset clamped only to the stale `user_count` (group.js:23); with 51 members on page 2 it requests offset 50, and the server echoes that offset with zero rows (app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22-34), so the list is empty and the pager stays on page 2.
